subject: angol
title: Travel and tourism
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató az utazási élményeidről, a közlekedésről és a turizmusról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: What is the most memorable trip you have ever been on? Why?
Do you prefer organised tours or planning everything yourself?
What do you think of public transport in Hungary?
Is it better to travel abroad or to discover your own country? Why?
What should tourists see if they visit Hungary for the first time?
How has the internet changed the way people travel?
followUps: Do you trust online reviews of hotels and restaurants?

questions.q: Have you ever had a problem while travelling? What happened?
Would you like to travel alone one day? Why or why not?
Do you think tourism does more good or more harm to popular cities?
How do you think people will travel fifty years from now?

usefulPhrases.en: I prefer to plan everything myself.
Things didn't go according to plan.
usefulPhrases.hu: A dolgok nem a terv szerint alakultak.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What is the most memorable trip you have ever been on? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Probably our class trip to Kraków two years ago. Apart from the beautiful old town, we visited Auschwitz, which was a deeply moving experience. I think I learnt more about history that day than in a whole year of lessons.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you prefer organised tours or planning everything yourself?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Because I like the freedom of deciding where to go and how long to stay. Organised tours are convenient, but you spend hours on a coach and only see what everybody else sees. Besides, for me, planning a trip is half the fun.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you think of public transport in Hungary?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's a mixed bag. In Budapest it's quite good, and since the national monthly pass was introduced, it's become much more affordable to travel around the country. However, trains are often late, and some of the carriages are really old.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What should tourists see if they visit Hungary for the first time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Budapest, obviously, but I'd also recommend Lake Balaton and the Tokaj wine region. And if they want something less touristy, Pécs is a lovely city with a Mediterranean feel and lots of Roman and Ottoman heritage.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre véleményt mond és megindokolja, a rövid válasz után a visszakérdezésre három érvvel felel, a turisztikai kérdésnél pedig konkrét, változatos magyar úti célokat ajánl.

Nyelvhelyesség: B2-es szerkezetek pontosan – mondatra visszautaló vonatkozó mellékmondat (which was a deeply moving experience), összehasonlítás (more … than in a whole year), szenvedő szerkezet (was introduced) és Present Perfect (it's become).
Szókincs: az utazás gazdag, pontos szókincse (organised tours, coach, carriages, touristy, heritage) és természetes kifejezések (a mixed bag, half the fun).
Érdemes megtanulni: „a deeply moving experience”, „planning a trip is half the fun”, „It's a mixed bag”, „something less touristy”.
